speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to Dr. Agent's office. I see you are presenting with yellowish discoloration of your skin; have you noticed if this is getting worse or affecting your eyes? To begin our evaluation, can you tell me exactly how many hours old your newborn is right now?

speaker: Patient
text: 5-day-old male newborn. The newborn's mother reports that her child has developed yellowish discoloration of the skin that started from the face and then spread to the trunk since the past day. There have been no changes in his bowel habits or urination. The baby was born full-term at 38 weeks’ gestation via an uncomplicated vaginal delivery and has been exclusively breastfed every 2–3 hours.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Jaundice (Physiologic)
Based on the 5-day age, full-term status, and lack of significant feeding issues or dark urine, this appears to be a normal physiological process. However, to rule out severe hyperbilirubinemia requiring treatment, I need to see the results of your newborn screening. REQUEST TEST: Total_Serum_Bilirubin, Direct_Bilirubin.
